install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-e3efde71cc87586c30e9，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-web-launcher 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web 的 Windows 桌面启动器插件，创建受管理的快捷方式，后续启动会在后台重启 DSH 并刷新已有浏览器页面。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e3efde71cc87586c30e9.html
posts.en:
dsh-web-launcher is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Windows desktop launcher bundle for DSH Web that creates a managed shortcut, then restarts DSH in the background and refreshes the existing browser page.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e3efde71cc87586c30e9.html
